summary: Project initialized with canonical AIQT state files.

data.reason: Small resident tray app benefits from a native Rust backend, built-in tray/autostart support, and avoids bundling a full Node.js runtime.
No Pi-Hub agent installed on managed devices; standard SSH + /proc + /sys reads and docker CLI are sufficient and keep onboarding of new Linux devices simple.

data.decision: Windows OpenSSH client via process execution instead of an embedded SSH library
data.reason: Reuses existing keys, ssh-agent, and host-key verification the user already has configured; avoids reimplementing credential handling.

data.decision: Versioned local JSON persistence for the MVP
data.reason: Small data volume, no historical telemetry yet, easy to back up/inspect; SQLite deferred until historical metrics or audit history are needed.

data.decision: Read-only Docker monitoring in the MVP
data.reason: Reduces destructive-action risk and authorization complexity; validates monitoring value before Phase 2 administration (start/stop/restart/update) is added.
Prevents arbitrary command execution from the frontend, keeps parsing reliable and testable, and creates an explicit security boundary.
